description: Use when you need what one cloud charges to rent a GPU in one region now. Returns the price per GPU-hour, the last change, the source URL and when it was read. 50 free calls a day, then $0.01 USDC on Base per call via x402.

chip.description: GPU family, for example H100, A100, H200, B200, B300 or GB200.

region.description: One region, by code or name, for example us-east-1, eastus or East US.
